slides.title: Robo AI Demo
slides.subtitle: From fragmented AI tools to an operational delivery system

slides.title: The bottleneck is no longer access to AI — it is orchestration across real work
slides.body: Teams already have multiple AI tools. The operational gap appears when those tools must coordinate with people, data, approvals, and existing systems.
slides.proof: Design the workflow first. Choose models and agents as interchangeable execution components.

slides.title: A useful AI demo should make value visible at three operating levels

metrics.label: 01 · TIME
metrics.note: Reduce handoffs and repeated manual steps.

metrics.label: 02 · QUALITY
metrics.note: Make rules, evidence, and review points explicit.

metrics.label: 03 · SCALE
metrics.note: Turn one-off prompting into a repeatable workflow.

slides.title: Robo Lab connects people, AI agents, business systems, and evidence in one flow
The demo should show the workflow moving from request to reviewed output
The same system can support demos, pilots, and production without changing the visual grammar
Start from the business workflow, then add AI only where it improves the operating model

steps.title: Map
steps.body: Define the current workflow and decision points.

steps.title: Measure
steps.body: Track time, quality, adoption, and risk.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body: Standardize what works and integrate it.
